SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy <= 40
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 100;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  SUM(anglers) as total_anglers,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 2) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 45 AND fish_date_doy <= 60
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls;

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32), 1) as water_temp_f,
  COUNT(*) as measurements
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 55 AND ts_doy <= 65
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy;

SELECT 
  index_id,
  ROUND(value, 2) as value
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 6 AND avail_doy <= 60
ORDER BY index_id;

import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']

# Check all seasons available
print("=== SEASONS AVAILABLE ===")
print(trips['fish_date_season'].unique())
print(f"\nTotal trips: {len(trips)}")

# Compare periods across seasons - look for October/November (late season) patterns
# Let me map out historical data structure

# Assuming season runs ~334 days (April to November)
# Period 40-50 would be late May/early June
# Period 250-300 would be late October/early November

print("\n=== LATE SEASON PEAKS (Period 280-330) ACROSS SEASONS ===\n")

all_trips = trips.copy()
all_trips['period'] = (all_trips['fish_date_doy'] // 10) * 10

late_season = all_trips[all_trips['period'] >= 280].copy()

late_summary = late_season.groupby(['fish_date_season', 'period', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
})

late_summary['yt_per_angler'] = late_summary['yt'] / late_summary['anglers']
late_summary = late_summary.reset_index()
late_summary = late_summary[late_summary['yt'] > 0].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)

print(late_summary[['fish_date_season', 'period', 'cls', 'yt', 'anglers', 'yt_per_angler']].head(30))

print("\n\n=== SEASON 2 FULL YEAR PATTERN ===\n")
